newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields:3-,6-,9-mo down, 12-mo same.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields:3-,6-,9-mo down, 12-mo same.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-month, six-month, nine-month Ukraine treasury bills slipped and 12-month yields were unchanged from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Thursday.

Three-month bills slipped to 24.24 percent from 24.33 percent, six-month bills edged down to 31.27 percent from 31.30 percent, nine-month bills slipped to 34.84 percent from 34.86 percent and 12-month bills remained at 39.91 percent.
The results of Wednesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 3.00 million UAH 3.00 million UAH
Amount sold 3.00 million UAH 3.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 2.83 million UAH 2.83 million UAH
The central bank sold 30,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 24.
The results of the six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 27.26 million UAH 13.60 million UAH
Actual amount raised 23.58 million UAH 11.77 million UAH
The central bank sold 272,588 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 24.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 13.25 million UAH 1.30 million UAH
Actual amount raised 10.52 million UAH 1.03 million UAH
The central bank sold 132,556 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 24.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 30.20 million UAH 10.02 million UAH
Actual amount raised 21.60 million UAH 7.17 million UAH
The central bank sold 302,033 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 24.
